channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Conwy Tunnel set for six nights of closures with contraflow in place
item.description: The A55 Conwy Tunnel will undergo six nights of timed closures for essential maintenance work.

item.title: Opening date revealed for new Heavenly Desserts restaurant in Llandudno
item.description: Heavenly Desserts has revealed that its new restaurant in Llandudno will open next month.

item.title: Conwy school set to partially close on day of teachers’ strike action
item.description: A school in Abergele will be partially closed on the day staff plan to hold industrial action next week, its headteacher has said.

item.title: Llandudno & Llandudno Junction to see more trains in huge rail timetable overhaul
item.description: The changes will deliver a significant increase in train frequency and capacity between Chester and Llandudno Junction.

item.title: 'Where does the council tax money go?' Gwynedd Council approves 5.17% increase
item.description: Gwynedd councillors have approved a 5.17% council tax rise for 2026/27, pushing the average band D bill just over £2,000 as the authority sets a £379.7m budget and highlights soaring demand in education and social care.

item.title: Health board to remain in special measures - Betsi Cadwaladr issues response
item.description: "Our task now is to build on this momentum and continue strengthening services for the people of North Wales.”

item.title: Welsh Mountain Zoo on why chimp enclosure is open following heartbreaking baby loss
item.description: Mellony continues to hold her infant - behaviour that experts say is natural and instinctive among chimpanzees after such a loss.

item.title: Snakes, spiders and smiles! Llandudno Junction care home enjoys Scaly Safari visit
item.description: Residents had the chance to see and interact with animals they wouldn’t normally encounter - and there were plenty of smiles along the way.

item.title: Conwy councillors approve 6.5% council tax rise after lower proposal fails
item.description: Conwy councillors have voted through a 6.5% council tax rise after a lower 4.5% proposal failed amid technical issues and political division, leaving the cash‑strapped authority to plug its budget gap with a mix of cuts, reserves and higher bills for residents.

item.title: Llandudno pub owners 'extremely grateful' to re-open seafront hotel
item.description: A seafront hotel in Llandudno will re-open next week under new owners, who said they are "extremely grateful" to be at the helm.
